children: Kotak Alternate Asset Managers has closed its Kotak Yield & Growth Fund at ₹5,000 crore, raised entirely from domestic investors. The Category II AIF received commitments from institutional investors, family offices and ultra-high-net-worth individuals across India.

The fund had raised ₹3,900 crore at its first close in February 2026. It will invest across private credit, real assets and selective growth opportunities, focusing on cash-flow-generating businesses and mid-to-large-sized enterprises.
Kotak Alts said it will now focus on deploying the capital across private credit, real assets and growth opportunities.

title: Kotak Alts closes ₹5,000-crore fund, raised entirely from domestic investors
